keyEvents.text: Goal! CD Badajoz 0, Tenerife 1. Grant-Leon Ranos (Tenerife) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Marc Mateu.
Goal! CD Badajoz 0, Tenerife 2. Juanjo Sánchez (Tenerife) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.
Franc Mateu (CD Badajoz) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Juanjo Sánchez (Tenerife) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! CD Badajoz 0, Tenerife 3. Grant-Leon Ranos (Tenerife) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Gerard Valentín.
Aquiles Valentin Mansilla (Badajoz) Substitution at 45'
Carlos Beitia (Badajoz) Substitution at 45'
Goal! CD Badajoz 1, Tenerife 3. Carlos Beitia (CD Badajoz) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.
Roko Jureskin (Tenerife) is shown the red card for violent conduct.
Jorge Barba (Badajoz) Substitution at 58'
Lolo González (CD Badajoz) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
César Álvarez (Tenerife) Substitution at 65'
Iván Chapela (Tenerife) Substitution at 66'
Eduardo López (Badajoz) Substitution at 66'
Víctor Moreno (Tenerife) Substitution at 66'
Goal! CD Badajoz 1, Tenerife 4. Iván Chapela (Tenerife) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Martin Pecar.
Pablo Ollero Gómez (Badajoz) Substitution at 72'
Goal! CD Badajoz 2, Tenerife 4. Jorge Barba (CD Badajoz) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Manuel Hernández Suárez.
Jesús Álvarez (Tenerife) Substitution at 80'
Christian Gomis (Tenerife) Substitution at 80'
Aquiles Valentin Mansilla (CD Badajoz) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! CD Badajoz 2, Tenerife 5. Víctor Moreno (Tenerife) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by César Álvarez.
